name: relative_spread

name: depth_bid_1
definition: sum(bid qty 1..1)

name: depth_bid_3
definition: sum(bid qty 1..3)

name: depth_bid_5
definition: sum(bid qty 1..5)

name: depth_bid_10
definition: sum(bid qty 1..10)

name: depth_ask_1
definition: sum(ask qty 1..1)

name: depth_ask_3
definition: sum(ask qty 1..3)

name: depth_ask_5
definition: sum(ask qty 1..5)

name: depth_ask_10
definition: sum(ask qty 1..10)

name: di_1
definition: (depth_bid_1-depth_ask_1)/(depth_bid_1+depth_ask_1)

name: di_3
definition: (depth_bid_3-depth_ask_3)/(depth_bid_3+depth_ask_3)

name: di_5
definition: (depth_bid_5-depth_ask_5)/(depth_bid_5+depth_ask_5)

name: di_10
definition: (depth_bid_10-depth_ask_10)/(depth_bid_10+depth_ask_10)

name: acc_price_diff
definition: sum(ask price 1..10)-sum(bid price 1..10)

name: acc_size_diff
definition: sum(bid qty 1..10)-sum(ask qty 1..10)

name: depth_hhi_bid
definition: sum((q_i/sum(q))^2) over bid levels

name: depth_hhi_ask
definition: sum((q_i/sum(q))^2) over ask levels

name: slope_bid
definition: OLS slope of cumulative bid depth share on distance from mid in ticks

name: slope_ask
definition: OLS slope of cumulative ask depth share on distance from mid in ticks

name: quote_age_s
definition: bar_end minus timestamp of latest snapshot at or before bar_end

name: stale_quote
definition: 1 if quote_age_s > max_quote_age

name: snap_count
definition: snapshots inside the bar

name: valid_l1
definition: 1 if ask1 > 0 and bid1 > 0

name: locked_count
definition: snapshots with bid1 == ask1

name: crossed_count
definition: snapshots with bid1 > ask1

name: twap_mid
definition: time weighted mid over the bar, stale segments excluded

name: twap_spread
definition: time weighted spread over the bar

name: twap_wm
definition: time weighted weighted_mid over the bar

name: twap_coverage
definition: share of the bar covered by non-stale valid quotes

name: mid_open
definition: first observed mid inside the bar

name: mid_close
definition: mid at bar_end

name: mid_ret
definition: log(mid_close/mid_open)

name: mid_min
definition: minimum observed mid inside the bar

name: mid_max
definition: maximum observed mid inside the bar

name: mid_range
definition: mid_max-mid_min

name: mid_std
definition: population std of observed mids inside the bar

name: realized_vol
definition: sqrt(sum of squared consecutive log-mid changes in the bar)

name: ofi_raw
definition: sum of Cont-Kukanov-Stoikov L1 quote OFI over consecutive snapshots

name: ofi_count
definition: snapshot transitions used for ofi_raw
